description: Generate synthetic, checksum-valid test IBANs for a country (119 countries, real bank codes). Without an API key: up to 10 a day per user. Name a bank to get IBANs of that bank: free samples without a key, any number with a paid key. Test data only, never for payments.

bank.description: Optional bank name, BIC or bank code, e.g. "Deutsche Bank"

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. "Germany", "DE", "UK"

name: generate_test_ibans
title: Generate test IBANs
